scripts.supabase:sync-env:
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const root=process.cwd();const supaPath=path.join(root,'supabase-legal','.env');if(!fs.existsSync(supaPath)){process.stderr.write('missing supabase-legal/.env
');process.exit(1);}const supaText=fs.readFileSync(supaPath,'utf8');const supaVars={};for(const line of supaText.split(/?
/)){if(!line||/^\s*#/.test(line))continue;const i=line.indexOf('=');if(i<0)continue;supaVars[line.slice(0,i).trim()]=line.slice(i+1).trim();}const url=supaVars.SUPABASE_PUBLIC_URL||'http://localhost:8000';const anon=supaVars.ANON_KEY||'';const service=supaVars.SERVICE_ROLE_KEY||'';const worker=supaVars.WORKER_SECRET||'dev-secret';const dst=path.join(root,'apps','web','.env.local');const examplePath=path.join(root,'apps','web','.env.local.example');const ensureFile=()=>{if(fs.existsSync(dst))return;fs.copyFileSync(examplePath,dst);};ensureFile();let content=fs.readFileSync(dst,'utf8');const setVar=(k,v)=>{const re=new RegExp('(^|\r?\n)'+k.replace(/[-/\^$*+?.()|[\]{}]/g,'\$&')+'=.*?(?=\r?\n|$)','m');if(re.test(content)){content=content.replace(re,'$1'+k+'='+v);}else{content=content.replace(/\s*$/,'');content+=`
${k}=${v}`;}};setVar('NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL',url);setVar('NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY',anon);setVar('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY',service);setVar('WORKER_SECRET',worker);content=content.replace(/
+$/,'')+'
';fs.writeFileSync(dst,content);"
scripts.db:migrate:local: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const run = (cmd, args) => { const r = spawnSync(cmd, args, { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (r.status !== 0) process.exit(r.status ?? 1); }; run('docker', ['cp', 'packages/db/supabase/migrations/001_init.sql', 'supabase-legal-db:/tmp/001_init.sql']); run('docker', ['compose', '-f', 'supabase-legal/docker-compose.yml', 'exec', '-T', 'db', 'psql', '-U', 'postgres', '-d', 'postgres', '-f', '/tmp/001_init.sql']);"
